Nothing else: weights, payouts, dust, layout, codec, contract. Vectors: rules revision 2 changes which terminal boards are reachable (the automatic bankruptcy's liquidation and handover, the one-click Stock Round turn, the Brown continuation, the window, exact private-funding relevance, the atomic portfolio) -- through holdings, pool percentages, prices, treasuries and cash moved by ordinary sales and transfers, and the hashed bankruptcy_record; no field the appraiser reads changes meaning, and each vector's payload equals its v12 twin's (the same board at pin 12) outside [1,33) and [91,123).
